$description: SKYPhoenix semantic tokens — HIGH-CONTRAST theme. Status: PROPOSED-DERIVED, NOT EXTRACTED (no high-contrast mode exists on CompanyWebsite; verified 2026-07-18). Purpose: WCAG 2.2 AAA-leaning overrides fixing the contrast failures documented in the extraction (secondary link 3.7:1, disabled text 2.5:1). Requires brand-owner approval.
$derivation_rules: Only extracted hues or their documented darker/lighter steps already present in the sites' palette are used.
Every text pairing targets >= 7:1 (AAA) on its background; minimum accepted 4.5:1 for large text.
Focus indicators widen to 3px and must never rely on color alone.
Windows High Contrast / forced-colors mode: respect system colors; do not override forced-colors palettes.

text-primary.$note: extracted heading color promoted to body text (~17.4:1 on white)

text-disabled.$note: replaces failing #9ca3af; still visually de-emphasized but >= 7:1

text-link.$note: extracted info-text hue (portal.css:263) replaces #3b82f6 links: ~8.4:1 on white, underline required

border.$note: borders darken so structure survives low vision / greyscale

brand-surface.$note: #1e3a5f on white 11.50:1 — extracted primary already excellent. Corrected 2026-07-20 from a previously stated ~10.9:1; recomputed independently twice (relative luminance L=0.041284). 10.9 matches no plausible surface — the nearest candidate, bg-subtle #f9fafb, gives 11.01:1 — so it appears to have been an arithmetic slip rather than a different pairing

focus-outline.$note: 3px solid, 2px offset, plus visible shape change

danger.$note: extracted error-text hue used as action color for AA on white

forced-colors.$value: respect system palette; no overrides under forced-colors media query
